$comment: PRODUCTION rate cards: what the UPSTREAM provider charges Kaana, per deployment. Baked into the image at /etc/kaana-rates/provider-rates.json and read when the serving task sets KAANA_PROVIDER_RATES_PATH to that path. Never a customer price (docs/cost.md). Amounts are integers in 1e-12 USD.

One file is one immutable rate-card version, registered append-only in provider_rate_card_versions at startup. A changed price, or another deployment, is a NEW rateCardVersionId; reusing an id with different content stops the process.

rc_xai_realtime_2026_10_16: xAI Voice Agent (grok-voice-3.0) under Kaana's xai-realtime slug. It replaces rc_xai_realtime_2026_09_30, whose only deployment (grok-voice-think-fast-2.0) xAI stopped serving on 2026-10-14; the old version stays registered append-only. The deployment id is the publisher's first observation of the new line, on the day this card ships (dep_xai_realtime_grok_voice_3_0_observed_2026_10_16). xAI's list price, read 2026-10-16 at https://docs.x.ai/developers/models: audio $0.08 / minute ($4.80/hr); text input $0.004 per conversation.item.create — unchanged from 2.0. A push-to-talk session is billed for audio sent and received (audio_input_milliseconds, audio_output_milliseconds); a server_vad session for its duration (session_milliseconds), never both for one span. $0.08 / 60000 ms = 1333333.33 x 1e-12 USD per ms, truncated to 1333333 ($0.07999998/min). $0.004 = 4000000000 x 1e-12 USD per text item (requests).

rc_voice_2026_10_16: the voice and transcription deployments Kaana serves. It carries rc_xai_realtime_2026_10_16's one deployment unchanged and adds file transcription, each rate the provider's documented list price converted to 1e-12 USD per audio millisecond and rounded down: dep_xai_grok_voice_transcribe_2_0_observed_2026_10_16 at $0.10 per hour (27777; https://docs.x.ai/developers/models, 'Speech to Text REST $0.10/hr'), dep_groq_whisper_large_v3_observed_2026_10_16 at $0.111 per hour (30833) and dep_groq_whisper_large_v3_turbo_observed_2026_10_16 at $0.04 per hour (11111; https://console.groq.com/docs/speech-to-text). Groq bills at least 10 seconds a request; the adapter reports that minimum as the request's audio_input_milliseconds, so the rate needs no floor of its own. The deployment ids are read back from the production inventory (snap_ea0d4ecf18806d21, issued 2026-10-16T03:49:49Z) after OxyHQ/Kaana#193 deployed.
